title: Sample Pre-Analyzed SVOC Lesson
license_type: Original project sample for this project
summary_ja: SVOC の基本例文。単語ごとの文法ラベル判定を試せます。

sentences.text: I found the book interesting.
sentences.translationJa: 私はその本が面白いと分かりました。
sentences.explanation: found は「O が C だと分かった」という意味で使われています。the book が目的語、interesting が補語です。

title: A Quiet Lunch Break at the Library
license_type: Original project sample for this project
summary_ja: 学生が図書館で静かな昼休みを過ごし、友人への手紙を書く短い読解文です。
text: On a warm spring afternoon, a student decided to spend her lunch hour quietly in the old library, where the smell of books and the calm atmosphere helped her think. She carried a sandwich, a small notebook, and a pencil, and she sat near a window that looked out onto a narrow lane lined with cherry trees. While she ate, she observed people passing slowly outside, some carrying umbrellas even though the sky was clear, and she wondered about their stories. After finishing her meal, she opened her notebook and wrote a short letter to a friend who was moving to another city, explaining how comforting it felt to have a peaceful break in such a familiar place. The gentle silence of the library made the words come more easily, and she felt ready to return to her classes with a clearer mind. She planned to visit the same place again next week with a new book.

sentences.text: On a warm spring afternoon, a student decided to spend her lunch hour quietly in the old library, where the smell of books and the calm atmosphere helped her think.
sentences.translationJa: 暖かい春の午後、ある学生は昼休みを古い図書館で静かに過ごすことにしました。そこでは本の匂いと落ち着いた雰囲気が、彼女が考える助けになりました。
sentences.explanation: On a warm spring afternoon は時の修飾語です。a student が主語、decided が動詞、to spend ... が目的語です。where以下は複雑な補足説明なので採点対象外です。

sentences.text: She carried a sandwich, a small notebook, and a pencil, and she sat near a window that looked out onto a narrow lane lined with cherry trees.
sentences.translationJa: 彼女はサンドイッチ、小さなノート、鉛筆を持ち、桜の木が並ぶ細い小道を見渡せる窓の近くに座りました。
sentences.explanation: She carried ... の SVO と、she sat near a window の SV+M を中心に採点します。that以下の関係詞節は採点対象外です。

sentences.text: While she ate, she observed people passing slowly outside, some carrying umbrellas even though the sky was clear, and she wondered about their stories.
sentences.translationJa: 食べている間、彼女は外をゆっくり通り過ぎる人々を観察しました。空は晴れているのに傘を持っている人もいて、彼女は彼らの物語に思いを巡らせました。
sentences.explanation: While she ate は時の修飾節です。she observed ... と she wondered ... の主節中心で採点し、中間の複雑説明部は対象外です。

sentences.text: After finishing her meal, she opened her notebook and wrote a short letter to a friend who was moving to another city, explaining how comforting it felt to have a peaceful break in such a familiar place.
sentences.translationJa: 食事を終えた後、彼女はノートを開き、別の街へ引っ越す友人に短い手紙を書きました。そして、よく知った場所で穏やかな休みを持つことがどれほど心地よく感じられたかを説明しました。
sentences.explanation: After finishing her meal は修飾語です。she opened ... and wrote ... を主節として採点し、who節と explaining 以下の複雑部は対象外です。

sentences.text: The gentle silence of the library made the words come more easily, and she felt ready to return to her classes with a clearer mind.
sentences.translationJa: 図書館の穏やかな静けさのおかげで言葉がより自然に浮かび、彼女はすっきりした気持ちで授業に戻る準備ができたと感じました。
sentences.explanation: 前半は make + O + C の SVOC、後半は felt + C の SVC です。to return ... と with ... は修飾語として扱います。

sentences.text: She planned to visit the same place again next week with a new book.
sentences.translationJa: 彼女は来週、新しい本を持って同じ場所をまた訪れるつもりでした。
sentences.explanation: She が主語、planned が動詞、to visit the same place again next week with a new book 全体を目的語として扱います。

title: An Unexpected Delay on the Morning Train
license_type: Original project sample for this project
summary_ja: 朝の電車遅延を、読書と会話の時間に変えた人物の経験を描く読解文です。
text: Every morning, Thomas took the same train to work. It was always on time, and he had grown comfortable with the routine. But one Tuesday, something unusual happened. The train stopped suddenly between stations, and the conductor announced a delay. No one knew how long they would have to wait. Passengers around him began to feel frustrated, but Thomas decided to use the time differently. He opened his book and started to read. A woman sitting next to him noticed what he was doing and smiled. They began to talk about books and travel. By the time the train started moving again, thirty minutes had passed, but Thomas felt happy. He had made a new friend instead of wasting his time. He realized that sometimes unexpected moments can bring unexpected joy.

sentences.text: Every morning, Thomas took the same train to work.
sentences.translationJa: 毎朝、トーマスは同じ電車で仕事へ向かっていました。
sentences.explanation: Thomas が主語、took が動詞、the same train が目的語です。Every morning と to work は修飾語です。

sentences.text: It was always on time, and he had grown comfortable with the routine.
sentences.translationJa: その電車はいつも時間どおりで、彼はその習慣に慣れて心地よく感じるようになっていました。
sentences.explanation: It was always on time は SVC、he had grown comfortable with the routine も SVC です。always は修飾語です。

sentences.text: But one Tuesday, something unusual happened.
sentences.translationJa: しかし、ある火曜日に珍しいことが起こりました。
sentences.explanation: one Tuesday は時を表す修飾語です。something unusual が主語、happened が動詞です。

sentences.text: The train stopped suddenly between stations, and the conductor announced a delay.
sentences.translationJa: 電車は駅と駅の間で突然止まり、車掌が遅延を知らせました。
sentences.explanation: The train stopped suddenly between stations は SV、the conductor announced a delay は SVO です。

sentences.text: No one knew how long they would have to wait.
sentences.translationJa: どれくらい待たなければならないのか、誰にも分かりませんでした。
sentences.explanation: No one が主語、knew が動詞、how long they would have to wait 全体が目的語です。

sentences.text: Passengers around him began to feel frustrated, but Thomas decided to use the time differently.
sentences.translationJa: 彼の周りの乗客は苛立ちを感じ始めましたが、トーマスはその時間を違うように使うことにしました。
sentences.explanation: Passengers around him began to feel frustrated は SVO、Thomas decided to use the time differently も SVO です。

sentences.text: He opened his book and started to read.
sentences.translationJa: 彼は本を開いて読み始めました。
sentences.explanation: He opened his book と started to read が並ぶ複合述語です。どちらも O を伴う形で扱います。

sentences.text: A woman sitting next to him noticed what he was doing and smiled.
sentences.translationJa: 彼の隣に座っていた女性が、彼がしていることに気づいて微笑みました。
sentences.explanation: A woman sitting next to him が主語です。noticed の目的語は what he was doing 全体で、smiled が続きます。

sentences.text: They began to talk about books and travel.
sentences.translationJa: 彼らは本や旅行について話し始めました。
sentences.explanation: They が主語、began が動詞で、to talk about books and travel 全体を目的語として扱います。

sentences.text: By the time the train started moving again, thirty minutes had passed, but Thomas felt happy.
sentences.translationJa: 電車が再び動き始めるころには三十分が過ぎていましたが、トーマスは幸せな気持ちでした。
sentences.explanation: By the time the train started moving again は時を表す修飾節です。thirty minutes had passed は SV、Thomas felt happy は SVC です。

sentences.text: He had made a new friend instead of wasting his time.
sentences.translationJa: 彼は時間を無駄にする代わりに、新しい友人を作っていました。
sentences.explanation: He が主語、had made が動詞、a new friend が目的語です。instead of wasting his time は修飾語です。

sentences.text: He realized that sometimes unexpected moments can bring unexpected joy.
sentences.translationJa: 彼は、ときには予想外の瞬間が予想外の喜びをもたらすことがあると気づきました。
sentences.explanation: He が主語、realized が動詞で、sometimes unexpected moments can bring unexpected joy 全体が目的語です。

title: Saturday Morning at the Community Park
license_type: Original project sample for this project
summary_ja: 土曜の朝の公園にいる人々と、穏やかな雰囲気を描くやさしい読解文です。
text: The park is busy on Saturday morning. Children play on the grass. Some families eat breakfast on picnic tables. An old man walks his dog slowly on the path. A young couple runs together near the trees. Someone plays music from a small speaker. People sit on benches and read books or talk with friends. A woman takes photos of the flowers. A boy rides his bicycle very fast. An elderly lady feeds the birds by the pond. Everyone seems happy and relaxed. The air is fresh and cool. The sun is bright and warm. The park is a good place to spend time with family and friends. Many people come to the park every weekend to enjoy nature and exercise together.

sentences.text: The park is busy on Saturday morning.
sentences.translationJa: その公園は土曜日の朝ににぎやかです。
sentences.explanation: The park が主語、is が動詞、busy が補語です。on Saturday morning は時を表す修飾語です。

sentences.text: Children play on the grass.
sentences.translationJa: 子どもたちは芝生の上で遊びます。
sentences.explanation: Children が主語、play が動詞です。on the grass は場所を表す修飾語です。

sentences.text: Some families eat breakfast on picnic tables.
sentences.translationJa: 何組かの家族はピクニックテーブルで朝食を食べています。
sentences.explanation: Some families が主語、eat が動詞、breakfast が目的語です。on picnic tables は場所の修飾語です。

sentences.text: An old man walks his dog slowly on the path.
sentences.translationJa: 一人の老人が小道で犬をゆっくり散歩させています。
sentences.explanation: An old man が主語、walks が動詞、his dog が目的語です。slowly と on the path は修飾語です。

sentences.text: A young couple runs together near the trees.
sentences.translationJa: 若いカップルが木々の近くで一緒に走っています。
sentences.explanation: A young couple が主語、runs が動詞です。together と near the trees は修飾語です。

sentences.text: Someone plays music from a small speaker.
sentences.translationJa: 誰かが小さなスピーカーから音楽を流しています。
sentences.explanation: Someone が主語、plays が動詞、music が目的語です。from a small speaker は修飾語です。

sentences.text: People sit on benches and read books or talk with friends.
sentences.translationJa: 人々はベンチに座り、本を読んだり友人と話したりしています。
sentences.explanation: People が主語で、sit・read・talk の3つの動詞が並ぶ複合述語です。on benches と with friends は修飾語、books は read の目的語です。

sentences.text: A woman takes photos of the flowers.
sentences.translationJa: 一人の女性が花の写真を撮っています。
sentences.explanation: A woman が主語、takes が動詞です。photos of the flowers を句として目的語にします。

sentences.text: A boy rides his bicycle very fast.
sentences.translationJa: 一人の少年が自転車にとても速く乗っています。
sentences.explanation: A boy が主語、rides が動詞、his bicycle が目的語です。very fast は様態の修飾語です。

sentences.text: An elderly lady feeds the birds by the pond.
sentences.translationJa: 年配の女性が池のそばで鳥に餌をやっています。
sentences.explanation: An elderly lady が主語、feeds が動詞、the birds が目的語です。by the pond は場所の修飾語です。

sentences.text: Everyone seems happy and relaxed.
sentences.translationJa: みんな幸せでくつろいでいるように見えます。
sentences.explanation: Everyone が主語、seems が動詞、happy と relaxed が補語です。and は採点対象外です。

sentences.text: The air is fresh and cool.
sentences.translationJa: 空気は新鮮で涼しいです。
sentences.explanation: The air が主語、is が動詞、fresh と cool が補語です。and は採点対象外です。

sentences.text: The sun is bright and warm.
sentences.translationJa: 太陽は明るく暖かいです。
sentences.explanation: The sun が主語、is が動詞、bright と warm が補語です。and は採点対象外です。

sentences.text: The park is a good place to spend time with family and friends.
sentences.translationJa: その公園は家族や友人と時間を過ごすのによい場所です。
sentences.explanation: The park が主語、is が動詞、a good place が補語です。to spend time with family and friends は修飾語として扱います。

sentences.text: Many people come to the park every weekend to enjoy nature and exercise together.
sentences.translationJa: 多くの人々が毎週末、自然と運動を一緒に楽しむためにその公園へ来ます。
sentences.explanation: Many people が主語、come が動詞です。to the park、every weekend、to enjoy nature and exercise together は修飾語です。

title: Meeting an Old Friend at the Coffee Shop
license_type: Original project sample for this project
summary_ja: カフェで昔の友人と再会し、途切れていた関係をもう一度つなぐ物語です。
text: Sarah arrived at the coffee shop ten minutes early. She felt nervous about meeting her old friend Michael again after five years. They had been close friends in university, but lost contact after graduation. When Michael walked through the door, she recognized him immediately, even though he looked a bit different now. They both laughed and gave each other a warm hug. They ordered coffee and found a quiet table by the window. At first, the conversation was awkward, with long pauses and uncertain smiles. But soon they began to relax and share stories about their lives since university. Michael had moved to another country for his job, while Sarah had stayed in the same city and become a teacher. They discovered they both still enjoyed reading and hiking, just like old times. Time passed quickly, and before they knew it, three hours had gone by. When they finally decided to leave, they promised to stay in touch this time. Sarah felt happy walking home that day. Some friendships, she realized, can survive long periods of silence.

sentences.text: Sarah arrived at the coffee shop ten minutes early.
sentences.translationJa: サラは約束の十分钟前にコーヒーショップへ到着しました。
sentences.explanation: Sarah が主語、arrived が動詞です。at the coffee shop と ten minutes early は修飾語です。

sentences.text: She felt nervous about meeting her old friend Michael again after five years.
sentences.translationJa: 彼女は五年ぶりに古い友人マイケルに再会することに緊張していました。
sentences.explanation: She が主語、felt が動詞、nervous about meeting her old friend Michael again が補語です。after five years は修飾語です。

sentences.text: They had been close friends in university, but lost contact after graduation.
sentences.translationJa: 二人は大学で親しい友人でしたが、卒業後に連絡が途絶えていました。
sentences.explanation: They had been close friends in university は SVC、lost contact after graduation は SVO です。

sentences.text: When Michael walked through the door, she recognized him immediately, even though he looked a bit different now.
sentences.translationJa: マイケルがドアを通って入ってきたとき、今は少し違って見えたにもかかわらず、彼女はすぐに彼だと分かりました。
sentences.explanation: When Michael walked through the door は修飾語です。she recognized him が SVO、even though ... now は修飾語です。

sentences.text: They both laughed and gave each other a warm hug.
sentences.translationJa: 二人は笑い、お互いに温かく抱きしめ合いました。
sentences.explanation: They both laughed と gave each other a warm hug が並ぶ複合述語です。

sentences.text: They ordered coffee and found a quiet table by the window.
sentences.translationJa: 二人はコーヒーを注文し、窓際の静かなテーブルを見つけました。
sentences.explanation: They ordered coffee と found a quiet table が並ぶ SVO です。by the window は修飾語です。

sentences.text: At first, the conversation was awkward, with long pauses and uncertain smiles.
sentences.translationJa: 最初、会話はぎこちなく、長い沈黙と不安げな笑顔がありました。
sentences.explanation: At first は修飾語です。the conversation が主語、was が動詞、awkward が補語です。with 以下は修飾語です。

sentences.text: But soon they began to relax and share stories about their lives since university.
sentences.translationJa: しかしすぐに二人はくつろぎ始め、大学以来の生活について話を分かち合いました。
sentences.explanation: soon は修飾語です。they began の目的語は to relax and share stories ... 全体です。

sentences.text: Michael had moved to another country for his job, while Sarah had stayed in the same city and become a teacher.
sentences.translationJa: マイケルは仕事のために別の国へ移り住み、一方サラは同じ街に残って教師になっていました。
sentences.explanation: Michael had moved ... for his job、while Sarah had stayed ... and become a teacher が並ぶ構造です。

sentences.text: They discovered they both still enjoyed reading and hiking, just like old times.
sentences.translationJa: 二人は、昔と同じように今でも読書とハイキングを楽しんでいることに気づきました。
sentences.explanation: They が主語、discovered が動詞で、they both still enjoyed reading and hiking が目的語です。just like old times は修飾語です。

sentences.text: Time passed quickly, and before they knew it, three hours had gone by.
sentences.translationJa: 時間はあっという間に過ぎ、気づかないうちに三時間が経っていました。
sentences.explanation: Time passed quickly は SV、before they knew it は修飾語、three hours had gone by は SV です。

sentences.text: When they finally decided to leave, they promised to stay in touch this time.
sentences.translationJa: ついに帰ることにしたとき、二人は今回は連絡を取り続けると約束しました。
sentences.explanation: When they finally decided to leave は修飾語です。they promised の目的語は to stay in touch です。this time は修飾語です。

sentences.text: Sarah felt happy walking home that day.
sentences.translationJa: その日、サラは幸せな気持ちで家へ歩いて帰りました。
sentences.explanation: Sarah が主語、felt が動詞、happy が補語です。walking home that day は修飾語です。

sentences.text: Some friendships, she realized, can survive long periods of silence.
sentences.translationJa: 彼女は、いくつかの友情は長い沈黙の期間を乗り越えられるのだと気づきました。
sentences.explanation: Some friendships が主語、can survive が動詞、long periods of silence が目的語です。she realized は挿入句で採点対象外です。

title: Preparing a Short Presentation at Home
license_type: Original project sample for this project
summary_ja: 英語クラスの短い発表に向けて、家で練習しながら内容を整える夜の様子を描いた読解文です。
text: Mina had to give a short presentation about local festivals in her English class on Friday. After dinner on Wednesday, she spread her notes on the kitchen table and chose three photos that showed music, food, and bright street lights. She practiced each part in a clear voice, timed herself with her phone, and marked difficult words so she would not pause for too long. When her younger brother listened, he suggested that she smile more and look up instead of staring at her paper, and she rewrote two lines. By the end of the evening, Mina still felt nervous, but she could finish in under four minutes and packed her notes before bed.

sentences.text: Mina had to give a short presentation about local festivals in her English class on Friday.
sentences.translationJa: ミナは金曜日に英語の授業で地域の祭りについて短い発表をしなければなりませんでした。

tokens.meaningJa: しなければならなかった

meaningsJa: しなければならなかった

sentences.explanation: Mina が主語、had to give が動詞、a short presentation about local festivals が目的語です。in her English class と on Friday は修飾語です。

sentences.text: After dinner on Wednesday, she spread her notes on the kitchen table and chose three photos that showed music, food, and bright street lights.
sentences.translationJa: 水曜日の夕食後、彼女は台所のテーブルにノートを広げ、音楽や食べ物、明るい通りの灯りが写った3枚の写真を選びました。
sentences.explanation: After dinner on Wednesday は時の修飾語です。she が主語で、spread と chose が並列の動詞です。

sentences.text: She practiced each part in a clear voice, timed herself with her phone, and marked difficult words so she would not pause for too long.
sentences.translationJa: 彼女は各パートをはっきりした声で練習し、スマホで時間を測り、難しい語には印をつけて長く止まらないようにしました。
sentences.explanation: She が主語で、practiced・timed・marked が並列の動詞です。so 以下は修飾語として扱います。

sentences.text: When her younger brother listened, he suggested that she smile more and look up instead of staring at her paper, and she rewrote two lines.
sentences.translationJa: 弟が聞いてくれたとき、彼はもっと笑って紙ばかり見ずに顔を上げたほうがよいと助言し、彼女は2行を書き直しました。
sentences.explanation: When her younger brother listened は時の修飾節です。he suggested の内容全体を目的語として扱い、後半は she rewrote two lines の SVO です。

sentences.text: By the end of the evening, Mina still felt nervous, but she could finish in under four minutes and packed her notes before bed.
sentences.translationJa: 夜の終わりには、ミナはまだ緊張していましたが、4分以内で終えられるようになり、寝る前にノートをかばんにしまいました。
sentences.explanation: By the end of the evening は時の修飾語です。前半は Mina felt nervous の SVC、後半は she could finish と packed her notes の並列構造です。
